description: Connect a Feishu custom app and sync accessible Drive folders, documents, sheets, slides, Bitable bases, and wiki pages into LensNode workspaces.

datasource.description: Synchronize one or more accessible Feishu resource URLs into a LensNode workspace.

app_id.title: App ID
app_id.description: App ID from a published Feishu custom app with the required document permissions.

app_secret.title: App Secret
app_secret.description: App Secret for the same Feishu custom app. It is encrypted after saving.

resource_urls.title: Feishu resource URLs
resource_urls.description: One HTTPS folder, document, sheet, slide, Bitable, or wiki URL per field.

recursive.title: Include subfolders
recursive.description: Recursively synchronize resources in nested folders.

max_depth.title: Maximum folder depth
max_depth.description: Limit how many nested folder levels are synchronized.

incremental.title: Skip unchanged files
incremental.description: Reuse local files when the corresponding Feishu resource has not changed.

delete_missing.title: Delete missing local files
delete_missing.description: Delete local files when their Feishu resources are no longer present. Keep disabled to reduce accidental deletion risk.

tools.description: Read the text content of an authorized Feishu document.
